# ArcSecs / BEYOND SPACETIME

Independent, human-directed and AI-assisted physical-first research. Proposed mechanisms are hypotheses, not experimentally established alternatives to mainstream physics.

## Website
- Research hub: https://arcsecs.com/arcsecs-research-hub/
- Scientific physics-engine demo: https://arcsecs.com/arcsecs-physics-engine-demo/
- Cosmology comparison: https://arcsecs.com/standard-cosmology-vs-arcsecs/
- Research library: https://arcsecs.com/research-library/
